description: Read the gMSA managed password blob (msDS-ManagedPassword) and derive the account's keys.

telemetry.detail: DS Access reading msDS-ManagedPassword - requires object auditing (default OFF).
gMSA password retrieval by an unexpected principal is modelled by newer ITDR.

abuse_primitive: Read the managed password blob (e.g. GMSAPasswordReader/Certipy), compute NT hash / AES keys.
notes: Quiet read by default; the derived credential's later use is usually the louder half of the chain.
